meta.name: Anan SaaS Design System
meta.description: Comprehensive design system documentation for AI context, including colors, typography, spacing, and component rules.

principles: Minimalism: Clean white surfaces, no unnecessary borders or shadows.
Full Screen: Applications should utilize 100vh, removing outer margins/padding.
Clarity: High contrast text, clear hierarchy, and distinct active states.
Modern Aesthetics: Use of 'Inter' font, rounded corners (radius-md), and subtle animations.
AI-First: Interfaces should default to AI modes where applicable (e.g., Inbox).

layout.rule: Use flexbox for full-height layouts. Avoid fixed positioning for main content areas unless necessary (e.g., modals).

button.primary: bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2
button.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2
button.ghost: text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg px-2 py-2

input.default: bg-gray-50 border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-gray-200 focus:ring-0 rounded-xl px-4 py-2

inbox.style: Full screen, no outer padding, white background.
inbox.features: AI Toggle, Platform Icons, File Upload, Retry Mechanism.
